about_short_description.short_description: Cameo is a marketplace where fans can book personalized video shoutout from their favorite people.

product.name: Cameo Personalized Videos
product.description: An online marketplace where fans purchase personalized video messages from entertainers, athletes, influencers, and other public figures for gifts, celebrations, and personal occasions.

product.name: Cameo for Business
product.description: A service that enables businesses to commission personalized videos from public figures for marketing, customer engagement, internal communications, and other commercial uses.

product.name: Cameo Calls
product.description: A virtual interaction service that lets fans schedule live video calls with participating public figures for direct, real-time conversations.

product.name: Cameo Direct Messages
product.description: A paid messaging service that allows fans to send direct requests or questions to participating public figures through the Cameo platform.
